text:
Sasha: Heads up — onboarding 2 racks of hybrid GPUs (A500 + H100 mix) into the acme-enterprise dedicated pool next Tue. Need a quick quota sanity check + confirmation that procurement cleared the invoice. Anyone on procurement/vendor side?

Raj: I can take point on infra. Do we have vendor ETA and are these preemptible or reserved?

VendorOps: ETA slipped a bit, vendor says delivery window is Tue 03:00 PST. It's a hybrid allocation: mostly reserved with a small preemptible slice for burst. Will share serials when they confirm.

Olivia: We should check cloud quotas before we accept. I started a quota request (ticket PROJ-983). Can someone paste the current GPU quota from the project? e.g. run: `gcloud compute project-info describe --project=redwood-prod`

Sasha: Pasting quick output from `gcloud` for GPU quota (sanitized):
```
GPUs (us-west2): limit=520 used=512
GPUs (eu-west1): limit=300 used=120
A100 count (us-west2): limit=120 used=118
H100 count (us-west2): limit=60 used=58
```

DevOncall: We can free ~24 A100 slots by draining demo pools for a 2-4h window. Do you want me to schedule that? :thumbsup:

Marta: Procurement side: invoice INV-2026-0789 is queued and payment hold was cleared this morning. Finance confirmed funds, so vendor payment is good to go.

Raj: If the us-west2 quota is tight post-delivery, propose routing some allocation to eu-west1 as a fallback. Latency delta ~30ms for acme's traffic profile but keeps SLA.

VendorOps: We can split the shipment across two zones to stay within per-zone quotas. Also will attach SKU mapping to the invoice — ping me if you need SKU->model mapping.

Olivia: Quick infra PR created to add new TF tags and the dedicated pool config: https://git.company/repo/pull/4123 — @Sasha can you review?

Sasha: Reviewing now. Also we need an AMI bake and pkg install window — propose Tue 01:00-04:00 UTC for canary bake. @DevOncall ok?

DevOncall: Ack. I'll create a canary pool (2 nodes) and run smoke tests, then scale to 8 nodes if green. I scheduled canary at Tue 01:30 UTC. I'll post logs in this thread.

ProcurementBot: Payment processed for INV-2026-0789 (txn id txn_9a8b7c). Vendor ETA updated to 2026-03-24T03:00:00Z.

Sasha: Quick final checklist — reply with yes/no: 1) quota ticket approved? 2) PR merged? 3) canary scheduled? 4) vendor serials confirmed?

Raj: 1) yes (quota bump approved in PROJ-983).

Olivia: 2) PR merged (:shipit:).

DevOncall: 3) canary scheduled and smoke plan in place.

VendorOps: 4) we will send serials and rack map by EOD today.

Sasha: Great. I'll toggle the rollout policy to canary -> gradual and update the runbook. Thanks all.

Marta: Noted — I'll watch invoice and confirm when vendor confirms shipment tracking.

Raj: I'll follow up post-bake with telemetry snapshot and a short perf note.

Sasha: Closing the loop here — will post a short summary after the canary passes. :white_check_mark:
